meta.title: Multiple PO Split: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and verify that Multiple PO Split is refused or absent, then repeat as a Buyer and verify that Multiple PO Split is available; the catalog cannot switch user identities or operate this action.
Verify or record whether the tenant's RBAC configuration deliberately grants Multiple PO Split to additional roles.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and verify that Multiple PO Split is refused or absent, then repeat as a Buyer and verify that Multiple PO Split is available; the catalog cannot switch user identities or operate this action.; Verify or record whether the tenant's RBAC configuration deliberately grants Multiple PO Split to additional roles.

steps.note: Open a suitable existing awarded event so the tester can continue from the event context.

args.need: sign in as a non-Buyer user on the Enterprise tenant, attempt Multiple PO Split on one award, then repeat as a Buyer and record whether the action is refused, absent, or available and whether tenant RBAC grants it to additional roles

steps.note: The catalog cannot change user roles or perform or observe Multiple PO Split, so the tester must execute the role comparison.
Assert that the resulting screen remains free of crashes or server errors after the tester's comparison.
